title: Density readings graph, Phase III Utah film (Enclosure 9)
description: Hand-plotted graph titled "DENSITY READINGS" with density values from about 3.4 to 3.8 on the vertical axis and frames 0 to 50 on the horizontal axis, showing a single fluctuating trace with a sharp dip near frame 6 and a dotted section after frame 37. Annotated "NOTE — Phase III Utah Film" and "Enclosure 9". Stamped CONFIDENTIAL SECURITY INFORMATION.
